pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kokanade pāsāde sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhogino”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessanti ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.14.1: na sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍhessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.16: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.22: uddharitvā vā bhinditvā vā paṭiggahe vā nīharitvā vā chaḍḍeti,
